caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue standing on a black, rectangular pedestal. The statue represents a person with brown skin, long dark hair, and is adorned with a multicolored feathered headdress featuring red, yellow, and green feathers. The figure is dressed in a greenish tunic with yellow, red, and green feather-like decorations at the hem and neckline. The statue's arms are bent at the elbows, with the right hand holding a cylindrical object and the left grasping a long rifle positioned vertically alongside the figure. The clothing includes brown details at the wrists and ankles. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
